latest.title: Non-trivial ABC-Massey products on complex parallelisable solvmanifolds
latest.abstract: Triple Aeppli--Bott--Chern--Massey products, shortly, triple ABC-Massey products are higher-order operations on the Bott--Chern and Aeppli cohomologies of a compact complex manifold, and their non-vanishing is an invariant of its pluripotential homotopy type. We prove that every non-Abelian complex unimodular solvable Lie algebra admits a non-vanishing triple ABC--Massey product, and we deduce that so does every compact complex parallelisable solvmanifold.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 在非交换复幺模可解 Lie 代数上构造非零三重 ABC-Massey 积，并应用到复平行化 solvmanifold。
techniques: Bott–Chern 与 Aeppli 上同调
latest.breakthrough: 提供 pluripotential 同伦非平凡性的系统性例子。
latest.limitations: 非交换前提不可省略，交换的复环面须单独区分。 当前为摘要级分析，方法及结论须回查原文。
latest.priorityReason: 复几何高阶不变量明确，适合专门方向阅读。
